messages:
maria_privsec: Noticed a failed DSAR erasure run for user request 'req-0b9c' after yesterday's KMS rotation. Worker error indicates decryption denied for snapshots. Suspect RBAC change removed the delete worker SA during the rotation cleanup.
ashwin_eng: Can you paste the log snippet?
maria_privsec: ```
2026-03-14T22:07:11Z dsar-erase-worker ERROR KMSDecryptError: AccessDenied: projects/.../cryptoKeys/redwood-dsar: caller does not have permission
job=dsar-erase-0b9c snapshot_id=snap-77f
```
samir_ops: Oncall — checking. Which service account performs snapshot decrypts?
maria_privsec: `sa-dsar-orchestrator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
samir_ops: Looks like the key IAM no longer includes that SA with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. We tightened key bindings in an RBAC cleanup Friday and I think the script removed non-exempt SAs.
jlee_legal: The requester is asking for status. If we miss the 30-day erase SLA we need to log a retention exception and notify them. Legal ok with emergency remediation but we need audit trail.
ashwin_eng: Triage plan: (1) confirm alias -> current key version, (2) get key IAM policy, (3) check audit log for last successful decrypt.
maria_privsec: Alias points to keyVersion 4 (rotated). Key IAM policy shows viewer bindings only for infra groups; no dsar SA. Snapshot metadata shows `archival_hold=true` preventing deletion via archive pipeline.
samir_ops: Proposed short-term fix: temporarily add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `sa-dsar-orchestrator` on that cryptoKey for 45 minutes, re-run erase job, capture KMS audit and job output, then revoke. Need legal approval for emergency elevation.
jlee_legal: Approved for a one-time, time-limited grant to complete DSAR erasure. Approval note: "Emergency KMS decrypt grant for DSAR req-0b9c due to policy drift after rotation; documented and auditable." Please include dsar id and operator identity in logs.
maria_privsec: I'll collect required metadata: dsar_id=req-0b9c, snapshot_ids=[snap-77f], performed_by=samir_ops, approval=jlee_legal, retention_exception=false.
samir_ops: Applying binding now with the approval note in the IAM change description. Tagging change in infra-change log.
security-bot: Incident INC-4872 created: DSAR decrypt failure after KMS rotation. Severity=P2. https://incidents.redwood/4872
samir_ops: Re-running erase job...
nashwin_eng: If decrypt fails again consider rewrap flow (re-encrypt snapshots under new key) but that is more invasive. Also add an alert to detect when expected SAs are missing from key policies.
samir_ops: Success: erase job reports "complete: all snapshots purged for req-0b9c". KMS audit shows `Decrypt` by `sa-dsar-orchestrator` at 2026-03-14T22:14:05Z. Removing temporary role binding now.
jlee_legal: Thank you. Please upload: (1) IAM change record, (2) KMS audit entry, (3) erase job log, (4) DSAR requester confirmation once done. Legal will verify and close.
maria_privsec: Action items: 1) update KMS onboarding checklist to include DSAR SAs and rotation rehearsal (owner: ashwin_eng). 2) add an e2e DSAR testcase that exercises KMS rotation failover (owner: ashwin_eng). 3) design automated rewrap pipeline for long-lived snapshots to avoid manual intervention (owner: samir_ops). 4) create monitoring rule: alert when cryptoKey IAM loses any SA in the DSAR whitelist (owner: samir_ops).
ashwin_eng: I'll file the tickets and include runbook steps and approval template for emergency grants.
samir_ops: I'll draft the rewrap design and monitoring rule.
maria_privsec: Notifying support and product for comms. I'll attach evidence to INC-4872 and close when legal confirms.
security-bot: Incident INC-4872 status updated: Mitigated by samir_ops. Evidence bundle: https://incidents.redwood/4872/evidence
